description: MOSMIS crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C23 H27 N2 O10 Yb1 Zn1. From the CIF bond table, Yb2 (Yb) has 8 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors; Yb1 (Yb) has 8 O neighbors; Zn1 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.638-3.647 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.92-113.10°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C38H42ClN4O16TbZn2.
